theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cc_seg_line_hausdorff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a τ : Euclid P), ‖τ‖ = 1 → ∀ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet ((fun u : ℝ => a + u • τ) '' A) ∧ μHE[1] ((fun u : ℝ => a + u • τ) '' A) = volume A ∧ ∀ h : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ x in (fun u : ℝ => a + u • τ) '' A, h x ∂μHE[1] = ∫ u in A, h (a + u • τ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
